title: Treatise on the Plateau Oath Forms
summary: Binds the sabre to oath stones of the plateau and ends in the school form that holds an oath to its edge.

title: Canon of the Bearing Held Forms
summary: Takes a bearing from the night stars and keeps it through every exchange to the school form that never loses it.

title: Compendium of the Unwalled Sabre Forms
summary: Treats a sabre that fights on open land with no cover and ends in the school form that fears no open ground.

title: Treatise on the Seven Gale Bearings

title: Canon of the Edge Beyond the Plateau
summary: Carries the sabre's edge beyond the plateau by the light of a formed Core and closes with the school form of that reach.
